title: Resend section heading
description: An optional 170px app-icon slot, a light 56px grotesk title lit by a white-to-half-white diagonal gradient (an accent phrase can glow violet instead), and a grey lead. Centred or left-aligned.
notes: the icon slot shows a glossy placeholder tile until media (a looping video in the original) fills it
pass the title as a list to choose its desktop line breaks; phones let it wrap
name: resend-heading

props.name: title
props.description: the title; a list sets where the lines break on wide screens

props.name: accent
props.description: words after the title that glow in the accent colour ("…tonight")

props.name: text
props.description: the lead under the title; a list sets its desktop line breaks

props.name: tile
props.description: show the 170px app-icon slot above the title

props.name: media
props.description: what fills the icon slot (a looping video, an img); empty shows a placeholder tile

props.name: as
props.description: h2 for sections, h1 when it opens a page

props.name: textClassName
props.description: extra classes for the lead (e.g. its width)
